# A2UI fixtures

Copied unchanged from [a2ui-project/a2ui](https://github.com/a2ui-project/a2ui) at commit
`b8bee8fbd16f37afae8a6ba3f1ad16a76d305130`, under its Apache 2.0 licence (`LICENSE` here).

- `v0_9_1/examples/` is `specification/v0_9_1/catalogs/basic/examples/`.
- `v0_9_1/cases/` is `specification/v0_9_1/test/cases/`.

`tests/Yession.Tests/A2ui.fs` runs the binding in `src/A2ui` against them. To move to a newer
spec, copy the two directories again and update the commit above.
